close_reason: Updated reg! macro in jmap-tasks-server to use ClosureHandlerWithCtx; clippy clean
description:
Update register_tasks_handlers to forward CallerCtx using ClosureHandlerWithCtx<B, C> (from JMAP-exue.1).

All Task/*, TaskList/*, and TaskNotification/* handler closures receive ctx: C. Important for tasks servers implementing per-user property storage (keywords, color, freeBusyStatus, useDefaultAlerts, alerts) where the backend needs to know which user's properties to read/write.

Acceptance criteria:
- register_tasks_handlers closures receive CallerCtx
- cargo test -p jmap-tasks-server exits 0
- Clippy clean

Depends on JMAP-exue.1.
title: jmap-tasks-server: Forward CallerCtx in register_tasks_handlers
